digest.component_or_area: CI test sweep (periodic breadth workflow) & test suite install portability
propositions: Release and packaging tests compute repo root via Path(<installed_pkg>.__file__).parents[N], which resolves to <venv>/lib/pythonX under non-editable install instead of the checkout, causing FileNotFoundError when reaching for repo-only artifacts like scripts/release_guards.py and hatch_build.py.

The declared hatchling floor >=1.18 predates PEP 639 license-files table support; lowest-direct resolution installs 1.18 which rejects the current license-files syntax with TypeError, breaking wheel/sdist builds at the lower-bound sweep leg.

sweep (macos, full suite) and sweep (declared lower-bound resolution) are configured with non-editable installs (uv pip install) but the test suite was never made install-agnostic, causing collection and build failures that have been red on every scheduled run for 12+ consecutive days.

The scheduled Test Suite (mirror) workflow gates merge signal because failures on the macOS and lower-bound legs (which are NOT continue-on-error) mask real regressions under supported configurations.
